option_relations.rationale: The option 'Optic nerve astrocytoma' is a specific type of tumor, while the leaf 'Optic Neuritis' is an inflammatory condition of the optic nerve. They are distinct pathologies.
The option 'Primary optic nerve glioma' refers to a tumor originating in the optic nerve, whereas the leaf 'Optic Neuritis' is an inflammatory demyelinating condition. They are not related.
The option 'Optic nerve glioma (astrocytoma)' describes a neoplastic condition of the optic nerve. The leaf 'Optic Neuritis' is an inflammatory condition. These are different disease entities.

The option 'Glioblastoma (World Health Organization grade IV) with optic nerve invasion and intraocular extension' describes a highly malignant brain tumor with spread to the optic nerve. The leaf 'Optic Neuritis' is an inflammatory condition of the optic nerve. These are distinct pathologies.
